MembershipDuesReconciliation._comment: Lost-webhook safety net for membership dues (see appsettings.json for full semantics). Leave Enabled=false until the merchant order_id has been persisting to membership_dues_payments.TransactionId long enough to cover the LookbackDays window — rows created before that have only the numeric CfOrderId, which the Cashfree API rejects, and are reported as unresolvable.

Cashfree._comment: LIVE Cashfree (KYC). Replace ClientId/ClientSecret with the PRODUCTION keys from Cashfree Dashboard. Live payments require HTTPS.

CashfreePayment._comment: LIVE Cashfree (payments). Same live ClientId/ClientSecret as above. Environment must be 'production'.

ClubSite._comment: Shared secret with the club-website Next.js app. Must match PURGE_CACHE_SECRET in club-website/.env.production. Used by IClubSiteCachePurger after admin saves a change.

MobileApp._comment: Placeholder URLs — replace with real Play Store / App Store links.

RotaryOrgApi._comment: Set Username/Password via server-only edit — never committed to git.
